rv.q: Henner’s pitch-perfect performance captures the unflappable narcissism of an entire generation.
Ask poses interesting questions about generational political differences and wealth, framing them through a two-person showdown, the play never amps up the stakes enough to go all in on the drama.
Once the central conflict finally emerges, the production becomes considerably more compelling.

cn.t: Critics praise "The Ask" for its sharp, timely exploration of generational tensions over wealth and values, anchored by strong performances from Marilu Henner and Shannon Purser in this thought-provoking two-hander.
